name: Dania Academy
about: Dania Academy is a business academy in central Jutland with positive institutional accreditation. Its English Cyber Security bachelor begins in Viborg in September 2027, using small classes, group work and contact with local companies.

languageOfInstruction.note: The English full-degree catalogue links Cyber Security for September 2027; other international activities include exchange and summer schools.

notes: Cyber Security is the English first-year full-degree offering listed for September 2027; the campus is Prinsens Allé 2, 8800 Viborg.
Dania lists English B as a specific requirement but also mentions English C plus a test; confirm the latter route before relying on it.
Tuition is free for Danish and EU/EEA students and specified residence-permit holders. Other students pay tuition; the 2027 amount and payment dates are not yet announced.

support.academic: Smaller classes and group work with lecturers; student counsellors answer programme and admissions questions: https://eadania.com/programmes/cyber-security/
support.internationalStudents: International counsellors offer application, student-life and housing guidance. Orientation takes place before study start; Dania owns no accommodation: https://eadania.com/programmes/cyber-security/
support.careers: Company presentations, an internship fair and a six-month workplace internship connect study with professional practice: https://eadania.com/programmes/cyber-security/
